Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:

Water
 PUMP 
 Centrifugal pump
SOLOVIC, UGOSLAF
Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment maintenance procedures I1, which must be performed on an annually 
bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The technical specification of 
the pump SOLOVIC pump 
Q = 1000 M3 / H H = 100 M 
P = 400 kv V = 6000 volt

The technical specification of 
the pump UGOSLAF pump 
Q = 1100 M3 / H H = 107 M 
P = 500 kv V = 6000 volt

The 
first draft initiated and tested by eng.Samy Shehata 
Ebrahim, accepted by eng. Hanafy Fahmy Madny general director, approved by 
eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power 
Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS HPGC Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.... etc
Stop pump and switch off the power supply
Close the outlet and inlet valves

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrench
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating
Cleaning material

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the alignment of the 
pump

Operate the pump to check 
the noise

Stop pump and switch off 
the power supply and close the outlet and inlet valves
Dismantle the coppling

Dismantle the shaft , 
impeller , protection ,cooling bushing and check for defects or cracks

Check key and change if 
needed
Check the bearings if needed

Install the pump and 
make alignment with motor
Install the coppling

Operate the pump and check 
the load current
